milestones.title: Strengthen accountability in appointment arrangements for separated AG and prosecutor roles
milestones.description: DAP committed to pursue improvements through its select-committee representatives, including Ramkarpal Singh.
milestones.progress_note: This is a shared party and parliamentary-committee commitment. The statement supports scrutiny of the bill; it does not establish enactment, appointments or a completed reform. No numerical progress was verified.

milestones.title: Work towards signing the Malaysia–Korea Free Trade Agreement
milestones.description: In a speech delivered on behalf of the minister, Sim said MITI looked towards signing the agreement by mid-2026.
milestones.progress_note: The October 2025 statement concluded negotiations; it is not treated as proof of later signing or entry into force. A matching signed-agreement outcome was not verified. Mid-year supplies no exact deadline date.

milestones.title: Expand the national public EV-charging network towards 10,000 points
milestones.description: Sim described the government’s charging-infrastructure target while speaking at Toyota’s battery-electric vehicle launch.
milestones.progress_note: The speech reports more than 5,000 public points, not an exact comparable numerator. No 50% completion is inferred. This is shared national infrastructure, with no new deadline specified in this speech.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
